en.text:
Replaces <solar/>Healing Grenades' Restoration Orb with a Healing Turret. Consuming a <solar/>Healing Grenade will spawn a Healing Turret in front of you.

Passively highlights low-health allies with a soft, flashing, red glow.

Healing Turret information:
• Lasts 9 seconds and has 100? <link Construct [#CombatantClassifications] /> HP
• Releases Healing Seekers every 3 seconds towards the user and allies within 30 meters
• Healing Seekers apply <solar/>Cure x1 and <solar/>Restoration x1 for <pve 4 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds in a 7.5 meter radius (strength of both buffs is increased to <solar/>x2, for the wearer only, while <solar/>Touch of Flame equipped). 

Restoring health to damaged allies <pvp [6 times] /> spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy at their position. //Support Frame Auto Rifle Healing Shots do not trigger this.

10 second cooldown between activations.
